{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Identify and remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
real_orders = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue for real completed orders
mean_revenue = real_orders['revenue'].mean()

# Print the number of real completed orders
print(f"Number of real completed orders: {len(real_orders)}")

# Print the mean revenue
print(f"Mean revenue: {mean_revenue}")"}
